criteria.rationale: The patient was 49 on the September 1, 2026 request date.
The request is for Wegovy for chronic weight management, and the prescribing note identifies obesity as the treatment indication.
The August 17 note documents current meal-plan use and exercise 3–4 times weekly, with a plan to continue both alongside Wegovy. The March dietitian note specifies the reduced-calorie meal plan.

The patient stopped the meal and activity plans over the holidays and restarted on March 13, 2026. Through the last documented participation on August 17, the continuous period is fewer than six whole calendar months.
The latest structured BMI before the request is 37.3 kg/m², exceeding the 30 kg/m² threshold without a comorbidity requirement.
